description: What the bundled setup screen may do on Android/iOS, before any hub is known. Local only: the hub itself is granted its own capability at runtime, scoped to its origin, by mobile_hub.rs. `set-mobile-hub-url` is deliberately not reachable from a hub — a hub may hand the app back to this screen, but only a person may type the next address. The barcode scanner is what lets a phone read the hub's code instead of typing its address.
